title: Machine Prepending a Boolean Word
statement: Given a Boolean word $w$, define a finite Turing machine with no work tapes and state set $\{0,1,\ldots,|w|\}$, initially in state $0$. In state $q<|w|$, it emits the $q$th symbol of $w$, leaves the input head fixed, and advances to state $q+1$. Once $q=|w|$, on reading an input symbol $b$ it moves the input head one cell right, emits $b$, and remains in that state; on a blank input cell it halts without emitting a symbol.
